damageLaw: In the Pillow Fields a bear's body blow is a KO whatever the man's HP (the pounce, the landing, the Bluecoat's and the Emperor's sword, the hooves: any Sarge and Jane fall under a moving horse, the blade's block never rolls on the Emperor's cut). Three hits take bar hits instead: a glob 2 x the share (90 % + 10 % x bar / HP), a cotton lob half the man's bar x the share, a Bluecoat's cut on Sarge or a hero 1 x the share; a man left alone 4 s mends one bar hit. Difficulty scales the bodies (x1 · 1.35 · 1.5 · 1.8) and the head-counts (x1 · 1.25 · 1.5 · 1.5), never a hit; the Emperor's two bars AND his Bluecoats, officer and cannons also carry the price of the player's campaign rung past 50 when he fights solo (x1 in a party, or at rung 50 or under).
headlines: Every blow of the bears' bodies is a KO whatever a man's HP: the cub's pounce, the paratrooper's landing (76.2 px from where he lands, measured), a Bluecoat's sword, the hooves of the Emperor and his three cavalrymen, and the Emperor's own sword: three cuts a lunge, three men down.

Sarge is no exception: under a moving horse any Sarge and Jane fall, and the Emperor's cut fells a saber Sarge with no block roll (measured 10 of 10). The saber still turns half the globs, lobs, pounces and Bluecoat cuts (measured 14–28 of 40 pounces turned, both engines). At rest only a blade-in-hand Sarge keeps his feet under the saddle swing: a gun Sarge and every hero take the bar hit and a 181–185 px throw (measured, both engines); a hero at his last bar hit falls under the Emperor's hooves (the cavalry never take his last).

Only three hits take part of a man: a glob (2 bar hits x the share: 1.85 on a level-50 rifleman; 4–7 globs to a KO on a 7-bar man because a man mends a bar hit every 4 s he is left alone, measured over 40 runs), a cotton lob (half his bar: three lobs 3.5 s apart KO anyone, two a hero), and a Bluecoat's cut on Sarge or a hero (1 bar hit).

The Emperor fights on two bars: 152 · 233 · 287 · 390 each solo at the lab's levels 50 · 57 · 63 · 70 (152 x the tier x the price of the player's rung past 50: x1 · 1.136 · 1.257 · 1.422; the same price rides his Bluecoats, officer and cannons). A party pays the tier alone: 289 · 390 · 433 · 520 with two commanders (measured as born). On the horse he hunts and charges (420 px/s); at 0 he keels (measured: 0.8 s, EN GARDE!, the second pyramid), rises on foot with the second bar, and the cavalry and the EN GARDE! wave walk on within ~1 s.

His army never stops coming: the battery of 2 cotton cannons at the ride's start, a Bluecoat detail with the officer every 9–14 s while he rides (a battalion of 4 + a fresh cannon every third), and on foot a wave of 3 Bluecoats + 2 cannons every 8–15 s, every 6–10 s with no waiting once his second bar is under half.
MEGA changes the bodies (x1.8) and the head-counts (x1.5), never a hit: the Ice Castle's +20 % and double weather are not the fields' law. The stone wall and the reflect are switched off.

questions.text: The page goes to Raziya as is (through the dashboard and Wyatt's forward).

A balance read, not a bug: at the lab's levels every stock man is a one-hit KO to eight of the fields' eleven strikes, and Sarge too under a horse or the Emperor's sword; only the glob, the lob and the Bluecoat's cut on Sarge are counted in bar hits.

The Emperor's bar, and his Bluecoats', officer's and cannons' bodies, are priced by the player's own campaign rung past 50 (x1.422 at rung 70, x2.167 at 100, capped x4) on top of the tier when he fights SOLO; the lab's stock levels pay x1 · 1.136 · 1.257 · 1.422. Is that the bar the dashboard should show, or the rung-50 bar (152 · 205 · 228 · 274)?
questions.rec: show both, the lab's first (this page does: the HP shown is the lab's solo bar; the bars from 2 commanders up are a real party's)

questions.text: The paratrooper's landing reach is 76.2 px from where he lands (the row's 60 + 30 % of the man's width), and the landing point sways up to 9 px under the chute: a man 80 px from the shadow fell on some tiers and stood on others (measured both). The dashboard says 76.2 px.
The stone wall and the reflect are switched off (both switches at 0 in the client): the Emperor on foot never braces or catches a rocket. Intended since 0904 (Sep 3); the page says so.
MEGA brings no new hit to the fields (no +20 %, no double weather: the castle's law). MEGA is only x1.8 HP and x1.5 heads.

THE BOSS LAB's party slider does not show what a real party meets past rung 50: the lab's fight is solo with a party's bar, so its sheet keeps the solo price (2 commanders on MEDIUM at level 57: the lab says 443, a real party meets 390, measured as born). A party pays the tier alone by the twin-sim law (the price multiplier returns 1 while a party launches).
questions.rec: a read for Raziya; if the lab's slider should show a party's true bars, a small card (the lab's own sheet could drop the price when the party is 2 or more)

rows.t: A proposal (Nov 1, 2026), nothing in the game has changed. The game fells a man whose HP reaches 0, so a hit equal to his HP fells him and one under it leaves him standing; the three heavies are Wyatt's list; HP is each man's at the lab's level for the tier, as the page read it. A man a strike never fells today, or fells by bar hits (a Sarge with a blade up, the riot shield, the snowball bouncers), keeps that rule.
